_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::porous_media#4 and the execution that FALSIFIED it. The entry predicted a silent wrong-answer trap: omit the initial condition and the solver quietly starts from zero. It cannot. `initial_condition` is a required group of `porofluid_dynamic` and its `type` has no default, so deleting it aborts at parse with "Could not match this input" and the match tree line "[X] Expected group 'initial_condition'" from core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp; no time step is ever started (OMITTED_TIME_STEPS_STARTED=0). Starting from zero is meanwhile a legal explicit choice: type: "zero" parses, runs, and on this deck leaves all seven result tests passing (ZEROFIELD_RESULT_TEST_FAILURES=0) because the Dirichlet drive washes the transient out. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C on upstream porofluid_pressure_based_2D_quad4.4C.yaml.
